product.title: Nā Pali Coast Zodiac Raft Sea Caves Expedition on Kauai

description.text: On Kauai, fly across the ocean on an exhilarating guided Zodiac raft ride along the gorgeous Na Pali coast. The raft’s small size allows you to get into hard-to-reach sea caves, plus you’ll ogle pristine beaches, gushing waterfalls, and sheer cliffs. Stops include Na Pali Coast, Sea Caves, Coastal Waterfalls. This ocean adventure isn’t for the light-hearted, but the Zodiac rafts provide a thrilling and memorable way to explore this magnificent coastline from the water, as your captain and crew ensure your safety. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
